subject: Follow-up: DPA & SCC pathing + VSQ kickoff for Pulsewell
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@pulsewell.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: privacy/security checkpoints + asks

Hi Samir / Tiffany — thanks for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we are aligned: 

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Pulsewell will be processing customer messages and user metadata; you confirmed no PHI/clinical imaging flows today (you flagged plans to ingest limited EHR-derived fields in H2 2027).
- Primary legal stance: Pulsewell expects to act as controller for end-customer account environments; Pulsewell will want Redwood to be processor for inference/hosting.
- Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II in progress (control readiness assessment completed; audit scheduled for Q2 2027).

Asks / next steps:
1) DPA request: Samir / procurement: please confirm whether you want Redwood to sign your redlined DPA or prefer Redwood's standard DPA. We can share our editable DPA now (attached) for your legal team.
2) SCC module preference: we typically recommend Module 2 (controller-to-processor) for customers where the customer is controller and Redwood is a processor — that aligns with what you described. Please confirm if you prefer Module 1 or a tailored annex.
3) VSQ initiation: Neha will kick off a Vendor Security Questionnaire and will request SOC 2 interim evidence once available.
4) Timeline: if DPA/SCC preference confirmed this week we can circulate a DocuSign-ready DPA and begin evidence collection (goal: get contracting started before end of Q1 2027).

Attachments: pulsewell-demo-notes.pdf (call notes)

If that aligns, recommend we schedule a 30m legal + security alignment next Tuesday. Are you available?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@pulsewell.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tiffany Li <tiffany.li@pulsewell.ai>, procurement@pulsewell.ai, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: privacy/security checkpoints + asks

Jordan — appreciate the recap, that matches our notes. Quick answers below: 

- DPA: Procurement prefers to start from Redwood's standard DPA and then submit any redlines. Please send your editable DPA; we'll have legal review it and return comments.
- SCC module: Pulsewell will be the controller for customer data as noted; Module 2 makes sense. If Redwood recommends any specific annex for telemetry/metrics, flag that.
- SOC 2: correct — in progress. We expect to have Type II in Q2 2027; in the meantime we can provide a controls matrix and answers to targeted questions.

We're happy to do the 30m legal + security sync — Tuesday 14 Dec at 10am PT works for Tiffany and me.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel | Head of Product
Pulsewell.ai
samir.patel@pulsewell.ai

Subject: Vendor security questionnaire + evidence list (Pulsewell)

Hi Samir / Procurement — looping in Laura from Legal for contracting specifics. Per the recap, I'll kick off the VSQ and outline the initial evidence we'll request. To keep this lightweight, we'll request the items below first; we can expand based on responses.

Initial evidence request:
- Most recent SOC 2 Type I/II report or controls-attestation (if interim, provide controls matrix and testing schedule).
- Encryption at rest and in transit documentation (keys, KMS provider, TLS versions).
- Data flow diagram (high-level) showing customer data ingress, egress, and any third-party processors.
- Subprocessor list and locations.
- Retention policy for customer data and KV cache eviction policy for inference requests.

I've attached our vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (simple checklist) and our standard DPA (redwood_dpa_v1.docx) for your legal to review. If you'd prefer to start from your DPA, we can work off that as well.

DocuSign: Jordan will send a DocuSign link once we agree on the DPA version.

Next step: Samir — can you confirm Module 2 preference and share a point of contact for legal (name + email) so Laura can open a review ticket?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Privacy | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
